en: A single average cumulus cloud can weigh over 500,000 kilograms, which is roughly equal to 100 adult elephants.
A single handful of healthy forest soil contains more living microorganisms than the total human population on Earth.
Graphite and diamonds are both made entirely of the exact same carbon atoms, just arranged in different structures.
Because the water cycle constantly recycles moisture, the water you drink today could contain molecules that a dinosaur drank.
Venus rotates backwards compared to most planets, meaning the Sun actually rises in the west and sets in the east.
Neutron stars are incredibly dense, meaning a single teaspoon of their material would weigh about six billion tons.
Because the Moon has no atmosphere or wind, astronaut footprints left on its surface will remain for millions of years.
The massive 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake was so powerful that it slightly shortened the length of an entire Earth day.
The Atacama Desert in Chile is so extremely dry that some of its weather stations have never recorded any rainfall.
Pumice is the only type of rock that naturally floats on water because it is filled with trapped gas bubbles.
The Sun is so massive that it contains 99.86 percent of all the mass in our entire solar system.
The Pacific Ocean is so vast that it contains more than half of all the free water on Earth's surface.
